title: Big B Meets D-Light | Thomas UNHINGED Shorts
titleVi: Đại Ca Big B Chạm Trán D-Light | Hoạt Hình 3D Hài Hước
fullText: Just in time, Big B! Thanks, you can't escape that easily. Thanks again Big B. I got you Thomas! And I got you too. Help me Big B! Well well well, it looks like we finally found your weakness. You must weigh like 10 billion pounds! Maybe you should have laid off the coal a bit more. Hey, isn't that Percy over there? Where? Tracks is a mindset! And who are you? You can call me D-Light. Now follow me, I'll get you to your little friend. Hello Thomas, just one more stop and you will get to meet the big boss. You saved me, thanks! How did you even get here? Every road has some rail in it, you just have to look for it! Right on man!
